Both ratchet TWO-SIDED: an increase is a new defect, a decrease is a fix that must be re-recorded here with its cause named. Re-record deliberately with `node scripts/child-wider.mjs --write` and say what moved.

INSTRUMENT-GAP NAMED, NOT EXPLOITED: the per-component compile-receipt run (fresh mock per script) witnessed ONE real overflow this row does not carry — Tooltip's arrow "part-0-0-0-0" (a lucide <polygon>) at the mock's default 100px inside its 10px icon frame. Root cause is the svg-asset v1 grammar (path/g/circle; polygon refused by name → svg-child-outside-grammar), so the arrow ships as an unsized box part. countChildWider scans set-parented cells whenever ANY COMPONENT_SET exists in the mock, and shadcn's Tooltip builds as a STANDALONE component beside 8 sets — structurally outside this instrument's denominator. Widening the scan moves every library's committed number (standalone components exist corpus-wide) and is its own instrument round; until then this row's zero UNDERSTATES by exactly that one named overflow. See examples/shadcn/PROVENANCE.md.
